---
title: "Performance"
engine: knitr
---

```{r}
#| results: asis
source("lidarbench_report.R")
lb_banner()
summary <- lb_table("summary")
reps <- lb_table("repetitions")
timing_columns <- c("workload", "dataset", "cpus", "tool", "tool_version", "evidence",
                    "n_planned", "n_included", "n_missing", "n_short", "mean_seconds",
                    "sd_seconds", "cv", "median_seconds", "q1_seconds", "q3_seconds",
                    "min_seconds", "max_seconds", "tool_workload_mean_seconds",
                    "startup_overhead_mean_seconds")
```

## Validated results

Measurements whose outputs passed every validation level (or an explicit, frozen
accepted exception). These may enter [cross-tool comparisons](comparisons.qmd) when
the comparability gate passes.

```{r}
#| results: asis
validated <- summary[summary$section == "validated", , drop = FALSE]
lb_kable(validated, timing_columns)
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
lb_plot_repetitions(reps[reps$evidence_tier %in% c("validated", "accepted_exception") &
                         paste(reps$workload, reps$dataset, reps$cpus, reps$tool) %in%
                         paste(validated$workload, validated$dataset, validated$cpus, validated$tool), ,
                         drop = FALSE], validated)
```

## Descriptive results (performance only)

```{r}
#| results: asis
descriptive <- summary[summary$section == "descriptive", , drop = FALSE]
if (nrow(descriptive)) {
  cat("::: {.callout-note}\nThese timings include unverified or not validated outputs. ",
      "They describe how long each tool took on these inputs; they are **not** cross-tool ",
      "comparisons or speedups.\n:::\n\n", sep = "")
}
lb_kable(descriptive, c(timing_columns, "n_unverified", "n_execution_only",
                        "declared_comparability"))
```

```{r}
#| fig-height: 6
keys <- paste(descriptive$workload, descriptive$dataset, descriptive$cpus, descriptive$tool)
lb_plot_repetitions(reps[paste(reps$workload, reps$dataset, reps$cpus, reps$tool) %in% keys, ,
                         drop = FALSE], descriptive)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
lb_plot_mean_sd(summary[summary$section != "no_measurements", , drop = FALSE], "timing.png")
```

## Units without measurements

```{r}
#| results: asis
lb_kable(summary[summary$section == "no_measurements", , drop = FALSE],
         c("workload", "dataset", "cpus", "tool", "n_planned", "n_attempts", "n_failed",
           "n_timed_out", "n_interrupted", "n_skipped", "n_validation_failed",
           "n_validation_incomplete", "availability"))
lb_download("summary", "Download the full summary (summary.csv)")
lb_download("repetitions", "Download every included repetition (repetitions.csv)")
```
